notes: All ten R5 changes are present. Six need a final correction. (1) The EO 6179-A statements overreach, a defect that R5's own wording introduced: the order revokes presidential authorizations that it dates by the orders' own dates, so it is not evidence that the appointments were made. (2) The EO 3461 scope condition treats the general clause as settled, though the list may be exhaustive and the held list is incomplete. (3) 'Unused by April 15, 1903' survives in category (3). (4) The a_min examples ('widow of', professional degree) invite an assumed adult age, contrary to owner ruling point 4. (5) The Register identity-match criterion is missing. (6) The multi-person outlier does not say when the order as a whole ends. Not required: EO 3461's retention provision for war-order appointees is known only from the WPA summary, so it is left as a lead. Nothing else new overreaches.
